1187: newDamageType{
1188: 	name = _t("fire burn", "damage type"), type = "FIREBURN", text_color = "#LIGHT_RED#",
1189: 	projector = function(src, x, y, type, dam, state)
1190: 		state = initState(state)
1191: 		useImplicitCrit(src, state)
1192: 		local dur = 3
1193: 		local perc = 50
1194: 		if _G.type(dam) == "table" then dam, dur, perc = dam.dam, dam.dur, (dam.initial or perc) end
1195: 		local init_dam = dam * perc / 100
1196: 		if init_dam > 0 then DamageType:get(DamageType.FIRE).projector(src, x, y, DamageType.FIRE, init_dam, state) end
1197: 		local target = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
1198: 		if target then
1199: 			-- Set on fire!
1200: 			dam = dam - init_dam
1201: 			target:setEffect(target.EFF_BURNING, dur, {src=src, power=dam / dur, no_ct_effect=true})
1202: 		end
1203: 		return init_dam
1204: 	end,

669: 	if not no_procs then
670: 		hitted = self:attackTargetHitProcs(target, weapon, dam, apr, armor, damtype, mult, atk, def, hitted, crit, evaded, repelled, old_target_life)
671: 	end
672: 
673: 	-- Visual feedback
674: 	if hitted then game.level.map:particleEmitter(target.x, target.y, 1, "melee_attack", {color=target.blood_color}) end
675: 	if Map.tiles and Map.tiles.use_images then if self.x and target.x then if target.x < self.x then self:MOflipX(self:isTileFlipped()) elseif target.x > self.x then self:MOflipX(not self:isTileFlipped()) end end end
676: 
677: 	self.turn_procs.weapon_type = nil
678: 
679: 	--Life Steal
680: 	if weapon and weapon.lifesteal then
681: 		self:attr("lifesteal", -weapon.lifesteal)
682: 		self:attr("silent_heal", -1)
683: 	end
684: 
685: 	if weapon and weapon.attack_recurse then
686: 		if self.__attacktargetwith_recursing then
687: 			self.__attacktargetwith_recursing = self.__attacktargetwith_recursing - 1
688: 		else
689: 			self.__attacktargetwith_recursing = weapon.attack_recurse - 1
690: 			self.__attacktargetwith_recursing_procs_reduce = weapon.attack_recurse_procs_reduce
691: 		end
692: 
693: 		if self.__attacktargetwith_recursing > 0 and not self.turn_procs._no_melee_recursion then
694: 			local _, newhitted, newdam = self:attackTargetWith(target, weapon, damtype, mult, force_dam)
695: 			hitted = newhitted or hitted
696: 			dam = math.max(dam, newdam)
697: 		else
698: 			self.__attacktargetwith_recursing = nil
699: 			self.__attacktargetwith_recursing_procs_reduce = nil
700: 		end
701: 	end
702: 
703: 	return self:combatSpeed(weapon), hitted, dam
704: end

677: 	t = table.clone(t)
678: 	-- Default type def
679: 	local target_type = {
680: 		range = 20,
681: 		selffire = true,
682: 		friendlyfire = true,
683: 		actorblock = true,
684: 	}
685: 	for k, v in pairs(self.defaults) do target_type[k] = v end

250: 			-- Call the projected method of the target grid if possible
251: 			if not game.level.map:checkAllEntities(px, py, "projected", self, t, px, py, damtype, dam, particles) then
252: 				-- Check self- and friendly-fire, excluded Actors, and if the projection "misses"
253: 				local act = game.level.map(px, py, engine.Map.ACTOR)
254: 				if act and (typ.act_exclude and typ.act_exclude[act.uid]) or act == self and not ((type(typ.selffire) == "number" and rng.percent(typ.selffire)) or (type(typ.selffire) ~= "number" and typ.selffire)) then
255: 				elseif act and self.reactionToward and (self:reactionToward(act) >= 0) and not ((type(typ.friendlyfire) == "number" and rng.percent(typ.friendlyfire)) or (type(typ.friendlyfire) ~= "number" and typ.friendlyfire)) then
256: 				-- Otherwise hit
257: 				else
258: 					if type(damtype) == "function" then if damtype(px, py, t, self) then stop=true break end
259: 					else DamageType:get(damtype).projector(self, px, py, damtype, dam, state, nil) end

observations: FIREBURN defaults: 50 percent initial, remaining damage divided across 3 burning ticks.
ActorProject excludes reaction >= 0 when friendlyfire false.
attackTargetWith returns combatSpeed first and hitted second; STORMSTRIKE local hit receives speed.
